conclusion: All five program IDs exist and are executable on devnet at the same addresses and ProgramData accounts as mainnet. Every devnet binary DIFFERS from its mainnet pin (devnet DBC and DAMM v2 redeployed ~slot 503.2M; DLMM ~466.3M). Devnet upgrade authority DHLXnJd… differs from mainnet's JADaUV8…. Consequence: the devnet proof runs against different Meteora code than proof:local; per D-001 the mainnet-binary result governs and any devnet divergence is recorded.
